_readme: The load order of the dashboard, and the only place it is written down.
The server serves these files individually from src/test_hub/web/; the snapshot
exporter concatenates them in exactly this order into one HTML file. Paths are
relative to src/test_hub/web/ and match the href/src attributes in index.html.
Concatenate 'js' in order into a single classic <script> (no type=module: ES
modules do not load over file://), and 'css' into a single <style>. Replace the
marker comments in index.html rather than rebuilding the document, and write the
snapshot object into 'snapshot_global' at the 'snapshot' marker, before the
scripts block. Escaping </script> inside that JSON is the exporter's job.
